notes.title: Devolver Digital tease Metal Wolf Chaos s possible return
notes.notes:
FromSoftware’s Metal Wolf Chaos is a true game of legend. Under the cold, metallic shell of an Armored Core-esque mech shooter beat a heart of pure stars, stripes and apple pie. Starring an American president single-handedly thwarting a coup with his personal mech-suit, it was so American that not even America could handle it, and never left Japan despite being exclusive to the US-centric Xbox. Long have people cried for a sequel or port, and publisher Devolver Digital might just be teasing it.

notes.title: Here's Some Goodies
notes.notes:
We've been blown away by the amount of interest and retrospection our Steam release has generated, moments like these are what we strive for as content creators.

As a show of our appreciation, we've pushed out a new update that includes archived wallpapers and an earlier look at the game. The included build was demoed at Comic Con 2003 and takes place in an environment not present in the final game. A more polished version of this build with various changes was later released as a public demo.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32210502/3bdbea52f47a4334ba699fd0c2769197cc9339f7.png[/img]

Both of these additions are available for free to existing owners and can be accessed through the install directory. As with our recent Advent Rising update, we're always looking to add value to our existing games. We'd love to hear from you, what would you like to see in future updates?
